sec.title: August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 181)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 26** across American network and syndicated radio, baseball trailblazer Jackie Robinson discussing his MVP season with Bill Stern for Colgate, Jim and Marian Jordan in two historic milestones of *Fibber McGee and Molly* (winning 79 Wistful Vista in 1935 and the bedroom mirror in 1954), Skitch Henderson on *Twenty Questions* for Ronson Lighters, Art Carney as Red Lantern on *The Land of the Lost*, and Robert Dryden in *The Giant Footsteps* (1935–1954):
